mechanism.claim: The classical turning-point count is an ordinal randomness diagnostic. A completed high-variation BTC path with unusually few strict local extrema is directionally persistent rather than oscillatory. When its full-block and final-two-hour returns agree, follow that direction for eight elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of completed eight-hour return and final-two-hour return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVTPDCR counts only strict three-close ordinal extrema and ignores every return magnitude. HVDCS counts volatility-threshold state-machine reversals; HVCSR sums absolute second-difference magnitudes; sign-run candidates use consecutive return signs; recurrence and Lempel-Ziv candidates use different path objects. HVTPDCR reuses no event set or control and uses no volume, flow, funding, OI, cross-asset, fitted outcome, or amplitude threshold.

external_basis.origin: classical turning-point test for randomness of a continuous sequence
external_basis.fixed_object: an interior observation is a turning point exactly when it is strictly greater than both neighbors or strictly less than both neighbors
external_basis.selection_use: ordinal object and low-count persistence interpretation only; no incidence or outcomes

mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the causal upper variation tail targets July-like auctions, while the lower turning-point tail requires those auctions to traverse price levels with unusually few local reversals
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: three fixed UTC ordinal turning-point-deficiency onsets are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.block: 96 exact coherent BTCUSDT five-minute aggregates from 480 unique bars_binance interval=1m rows [D-8h,D)
features.close_path: the 96 completed five-minute closes in ascending UTC order
features.turning_point: for interior index i=1..94, one iff close_i is strictly above both adjacent closes or strictly below both adjacent closes; equality is not a turning point
features.turning_point_count: integer sum over the 94 interior positions
features.turning_point_rank: strict-prior midrank of turning_point_share over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank<=0.20
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared five-minute log(close/open) returns), strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.block_return: log(last five-minute close/first five-minute open) over eight hours
features.late_return: log(last five-minute close/open of the first bar in [D-2h,D))
features.direction_confirmation: block return and late return have one strict nonzero sign
features.onset: eligible now and immediately prior exact source-valid block ineligible; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: classical strict ordinal turning-point deficiency during high variation

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no ordinal definition, aggregation, rank, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.
